summary.text: Jill Alesch is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Nicole Hasso.
An attorney and Army National Guard veteran, Alesch says in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include public education, water quality and veterans.

paragraphs.text: Jill Alesch graduated from Denison-Schleswig High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Northern Iowa in 2000 and a law degree from Drake Law School in 2004.
She served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1998 to 2020, and in a Ballotpedia survey described a 22-year Guard career that included a Bronze Star.
Alesch advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

In the survey she said her campaign emphasizes funding public schools, accountability for taxpayer-funded private schools, lower child care costs, affordable housing, small-business growth, public safety and water quality, and she listed the Iowa State Education Association and the AFL-CIO as endorsers.
